output.summary: A large shrub or small tree native to the eastern coast of tropical South America, extending south to Uruguay and parts of Paraguay and Argentina. Its ribbed fruit changes from green through orange and scarlet to maroon; the edible fruit ranges from tart to sweet with cultivar and ripeness and is used mainly in jams and jellies.
output.edibilityNote: The fruit is eaten and used in jams and jellies; taste varies from tart to sweet with cultivar and ripeness.
